candidate_relations.reason: Glomeruloid hemangioma is a POEMS-associated mimic; the isolated scalp nodule with PAS-positive hyaline globules and D2-40-negative vessels is papillary hemangioma, not glomeruloid hemangioma.
Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma is a lymphatic (D2-40-positive) intermediate tumor; this lesion is D2-40-negative with pericyte-lined papillae, so the subtype is incompatible.
Angiokeratoma is a superficial ectatic epidermal/papillary-dermal process, not this well-circumscribed dermal tumor with intravascular papillae and hyaline globules.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Epidermal vascular ectasia versus dermal papillary hemangioma

candidate_relations.reason: Correctly places a benign dermal vascular tumor but omits the required papillary hemangioma histology (intravascular papillae, hyaline globules, D2-40-negative).
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Benign vascular tumor parent, missing papillary hemangioma type

candidate_relations.reason: Papillary hemangioma matches the scalp nodule with intravascular branching papillae, PAS-positive hyaline globules, CD31-positive/D2-40-negative vessels, and collagen-IV-positive papillary stroma.
Angiosarcoma is a malignant endothelial neoplasm; this circumscribed, HHV-8-negative dermal lesion with pericyte-lined papillae is benign papillary hemangioma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Malignant vascular sarcoma versus benign papillary hemangioma

candidate_relations.reason: Capillary hemangioma lacks the intravascular papillary architecture and endothelial hyaline globules that define this tumor.
Hobnail hemangioma is a distinct targetoid lymphatic lesion, not a well-circumscribed dermal tumor with PAS-positive hyaline globules and SMA-positive pericytes.
Dabska tumor is PILA, a D2-40-positive lymphatic neoplasm; D2-40 negativity and pericyte-rich papillae exclude that subtype.
PILA is lymphatic and D2-40-positive; this CD31-positive/D2-40-negative papillary dermal tumor is a different vascular entity.
Angiolymphoid hyperplasia with eosinophilia is an epithelioid endothelial proliferation with lymphoid/eosinophil-rich stroma, not intravascular papillae with hyaline globules.
Identifies a dermal hemangioma family lesion but does not specify papillary hemangioma required by the histology.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Generic dermal hemangioma, missing papillary type

candidate_relations.reason: Spindle cell hemangioma is a different vascular subtype with spindle cells and cavernous spaces, not this intravascular papillary pattern.
Squamous cell carcinoma is an epithelial malignancy and does not explain a CD31-positive dermal vascular tumor.
Intravascular papillary endothelial hyperplasia is organizing thrombus without the endothelial hyaline globules and collagen-IV-positive pericyte-rich papillae seen here.
Kimura disease is a lymphoid hyperplasia with eosinophilia, not a circumscribed dermal vascular papillary tumor.
ALHE is a distinct epithelioid hemangioma/lymphoid entity and does not match the intravascular papillary, hyaline-globule histology.
Retiform hemangioendothelioma is an intermediate hobnail lymphatic neoplasm, incompatible with this benign D2-40-negative papillary hemangioma.
Names a dermal vascular tumor but lacks the papillary hemangioma specificity established by immunohistochemistry and hyaline globules.
Pyogenic granuloma is a lobular capillary hemangioma, not an intravascular papillary tumor with endothelial hyaline globules.
